title: Personal Checking: posting a provisional credit on an electronic-transaction dispute
content:
## Situation and business effect

This entry applies to a Personal Checking account on which the owner has an electronic-transaction dispute under investigation. It governs the provisional credit posted to the account while that dispute is open, including its amount. Whether and when the credit is owed follows the general Personal Checking electronic dispute process unchanged: the credit is posted as one credit entry once the dispute is still submitted after its provisional credit deadline, and never before. Once posted, the owner sees the credit in the account activity at once, the posted ledger balance rises by the amount, and the dispute is recorded as provisionally credited.

## Posting the credit

The credit is posted with the internal tool **post_dispute_provisional_credit_5453b90d**, which the agent must first unlock (unlock_agent_discoverable_tool) and then call (call_agent_discoverable_tool).

**Capability.** One call writes one provisional credit entry on the account for the named dispute, dated today, with the reason recorded as a dispute provisional credit and the disputed debit recorded as the related entry. The account's posted ledger balance rises by the amount at once, and the dispute's status is recorded as provisionally credited. The tool records exactly the amount given and does not check the dispute, its dates or its amount.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Class | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|---|
| checking_account_id | Id | The checking account the disputed debit posted to, as returned by the checking account or dispute lookup | Reference number |
| customer_id | Id | The account owner's customer reference number, as returned by the customer profile lookup | Reference number |
| checking_dispute_id | Id | The electronic-transaction dispute being credited, as returned by the dispute lookup | Reference number |
| source_item_id | Id | The disputed debit entry itself, as returned by the dispute lookup (its disputed transaction) or the checking activity lookup | Reference number |
| amount | Fixed format | The provisional credit in U.S. dollars, always positive | Plain number, 2 decimal places, rounded half-up, such as 1234.56 |
| statement_cycle | Fixed format | Statement cycle into which today's posting falls | Written YYYY-MM: the month in which that cycle closes |

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the new provisional credit entry reference number, the dispute reference number, the amount credited in USD with 2 decimal places, and the account's new posted ledger balance in USD with 2 decimal places. Receiving it means the credit is posted and the dispute is recorded as provisionally credited.

## Calling contract Q&A

**Q: Which reference goes in source_item_id?**
A: The disputed debit entry itself, not the dispute record; the dispute's own reference goes in checking_dispute_id.

**Q: Does the tool check that the credit is due or that the amount is right?**
A: No. It records exactly the amount given and does not check the dispute, its dates or its amount.

**Hypothetical call (illustrative references only):** checking_account_id "CHK-EXAMPLE", customer_id "CUST-EXAMPLE", checking_dispute_id "DSP-EXAMPLE", source_item_id "TXN-EXAMPLE", amount 86.40, statement_cycle "2026-08". The receipt names the new credit entry, dispute DSP-EXAMPLE, 86.40 USD credited and the new ledger balance.
